verdict.rationale: Grafana SLO (a Grafana Cloud feature) lets you create SLIs and SLOs that define an acceptable level of service and how to react when it isn't met. Grafana Alerting can evaluate rules and route notifications. However, the evidence never explicitly mentions error budgets or burn-rate alerting, so those parts of the story are only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of error-budget tracking, multi-window burn-rate alert generation, independent or hands-on corroboration of SLO workflows, and clarity on availability outside Grafana Cloud.
